approved_acceptance.correctness: Zero unexplained conserved-state deltas, zero simultaneous active owners/stale writes, all durably acknowledged critical operations survive tested process crashes. Explain intentional consumption/death/decay with conservation equations.
approved_acceptance.recovery: Recovered or explicit unavailable state within60s after dependencies reachable; no consistency trade for timeout reassignment; no watchdog/deadlock/unbounded queues.
approved_acceptance.proposed_capacity: 30min steady plateau: TPS>=19.5 each60s window; worker/lobby p95 MSPT<=50ms,p99<=100ms; healthy transfer p95<=2s,p99<=5s. Thresholds proposed for approval; all samples/worst windows reported.
approved_acceptance.metrics: Raw tick p95/p99, sustained TPS, dimension/main thread/phase, CPU/process/host/quota/throttle, RAM/heap/GC, disk, network bytes/RTT/retries/queues, transfer stage and end-to-end latency, generator CPU/RAM/action completion/backlog. Existing MTMC aggregates need raw tick/main-thread instrumentation.
approved_acceptance.interpretation: 100 remains estimate,300 goal; active vs ghosts separate; regionalization incremental gain separate from MTMC. Single-host coordination not multi-PC performance. Added hardware vs same aggregate CPU budget separate; hot dimension limit explicit.
